Common look of the Shiny applications of the FISHMORPH family

Source: R/app-theme.R
app_theme.Rd

One bslib theme for the applications of Rfishmorph, intraitR and FishInTrait, defined once here – the package every other one depends on – so that a change of look is made in one place.

Usage

app_theme(primary = FM_PALETTE[["river"]], ...)

Arguments

primary

Accent colour (buttons, links). The default is the river green-blue of the data-management and exploration applications; the digitizer passes its own blue, so that its two action buttons stand out.

...

Further Bootstrap variables, passed to bslib::bs_theme().

Value

A bslib theme object.

Details

The look is taken from the subject: the colours of a river (deep running water for the accent, washed shallows for the page, the riverbed for the text) and of sunlit gravel for the rare second accent (keyboard focus, the active tab, and the dotted rule under the header – a row of landmarks along a profile). The type is IBM Plex Sans, drawn for technical interfaces, with tabular figures in tables of coordinates; its condensed width sets the titles and card headers, compact in toolbars, like the labels of an instrument. Species names keep a true italic.

The fonts ship WITH the package (inst/fonts, SIL Open Font License) and are embedded in the compiled stylesheet: an application has to open in the field, offline or behind a proxy, where bslib::font_google() cannot download anything.

The palette is also exposed as CSS variables, for the inline styles of the applications: --fm-ink, --fm-muted, --fm-line, --fm-wash, --fm-gravel and --fm-river.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("bslib", quietly = TRUE)) {
  th <- app_theme()
  th_digitizer <- app_theme(primary = "#2c5bb8")
}
